title: Min and Max
concept: Use math.min_int, math.max_int and related functions to find the smallest or largest of two numbers.
why: Comparing and selecting the extreme value is a common operation in sorting, game logic, and data processing.
syntax_ref:
math.min_int(a, b)   → smaller of two Ints
math.max_int(a, b)   → larger of two Ints
math.min_float(a, b) → smaller of two Float64s
math.max_float(a, b) → larger of two Float64s
tips: You need `use xiom.math;` to access these functions
Combine min and max to clamp a value within a range
common_mistakes: Forgetting `use xiom.math;` before calling math functions
Using `min_int` with Float64 values — use `min_float` instead
Mixing up the argument order — `min_int(a, b)` always returns the smaller one
